record.paper_title: Open problems on countable dense homogeneity
record.context_brief: squares of zero-dimensional CDH spaces and 1/kappa-CDH
record.original_question: For which cardinals kappa does there exist a zero-dimensional countable dense homogeneous space X such that the square X^2 is 1/kappa-CDH?

evidence.quote: Problem 28 (Medini [58]). For which cardinals κ is there a zero-dimensional CDH space X such that X2 is 1 κ-CDH?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A topological space $X$ is said to be countable dense homogeneous (CDH) if, for any two countable dense subsets $D_1, D_2 \subseteq X$, there exists a homeomorphism $h: X \to X$ with $h(D_1) = D_2$. For a cardinal $\kappa$, $X$ is called $\tfrac{1}{\kappa}$-CDH if there are exactly $\kappa$ orbits of countable dense subsets of $X$ under the action of the homeomorphism group of $X$ (equivalently, the countable dense subsets of $X$ partition into exactly $\kappa$ equivalence classes, where $D_1 \sim D_2$ iff some self-homeomorphism of $X$ maps $D_1$ onto $D_2$).

Determine the cardinals $\kappa$ for which there exists a zero-dimensional CDH space $X$ such that the square $X^2$ is $\tfrac{1}{\kappa}$-CDH.
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (Hrušák–van Mill and others, 2024–2025) constructs, under Martin's Axiom, a zero-dimensional separable metrizable CDH space X whose square X^2 is not CDH, showing X^2 has more than one orbit of countable dense sets. This addresses a related Medini question but the full characterization of cardinals κ for which X^2 can be 1/κ-CDH (with X zero-dimensional CDH) does not appear fully resolved in ZFC.

status_evidence.title: Zero-dimensional metrizable CDH space X such that X^2 is not CDH
status_evidence.snippet: Assuming Martin's Axiom, a zero-dimensional separable metrizable space X is constructed such that X is countable dense homogeneous while X^2 is not.
status_evidence.claim: A consistent example exists of zero-dimensional CDH X whose square has more than one orbit of countable dense sets, partially addressing Medini's question.

status_evidence.title: Countable Dense Homogeneity in Powers of Zero-dimensional Definable Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Results on CDH properties of powers of zero-dimensional definable spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Powers of zero-dimensional CDH spaces remain an active research area with ongoing partial results.
